failureInjection.question: Does head publication survive a second process holding head.json open without FILE_SHARE_DELETE (antivirus/indexer/backup/editor)?
failureInjection.result: FAIL: save rejected with EPERM after 17 ms, no retry. Revision 1 snapshot + receipt remain and history reports it verified although the caller was told the save failed; next save becomes revision 2.
failureInjection.impact: Spurious user-visible save failures on ordinary Windows hosts; commit point is ambiguous (snapshot exists, head not advanced).

failureInjection.question: Two independent store instances save from the same expectedRevision with natural timing.
failureInjection.result: 40/40 trials: exactly one writer acknowledged (link() on the snapshot name acts as an accidental compare-and-swap).

failureInjection.question: Writer B validates expectedRevision before writer A commits, then allocates its revision after A commits.
failureInjection.result: FAIL: LOST UPDATE. A acknowledged revision 1; B (based on revision 0) acknowledged revision 2 and became head. Root cause: nextRevision() = max(existing)+1 instead of exactly expectedRevision+1.
failureInjection.impact: Silent loss of acknowledged edits once any second writer process exists (worker, CLI-direct, MCP stdio host, second desktop instance).

failureInjection.question: After a hard kill of the Node service on Windows, do spawned processes survive?
failureInjection.impact: Local inference/ComfyUI/Python workers leak orphan GPU/CPU processes and partial outputs after a service crash. Node cannot create a no-breakaway Job Object natively.

result.oneDamagedRecord: FAIL: every subsequent submit fails and initialize() stays rejected (cached rejected promise) until the file is removed by hand
result.lifetimeCap: FAIL: after 1000 lifetime jobs all exports are refused ('Durable job limit reached'); no retention/GC exists

failureInjection.question: Can built-in node:sqlite (SQLite 3.53.3, WAL, synchronous=FULL) provide cross-process CAS + atomic idempotency on this host?

result.twoProcessContention: 6000 attempts: 5996 committed, 4 stale writers rejected; head == revision rows == idempotency rows == 5996; integrity_check ok
result.hardKill10x: 10/10 force-kills mid-write: integrity_check ok and invariant held every time

failureInjection.limitation: Process kill is not power loss; OS write-cache/power-cut behavior is not qualified.

failureInjection.question: Does the imported canonical serializer enforce the PROJECT_DATA_MODEL numeric/key guarantees?
failureInjection.result: Partial: rejects NaN/Infinity/undefined/sparse/non-plain/BigInt; normalizes -0. ACCEPTS unsafe integers (2^53+2) and '__proto__' keys. Guarantees must be enforced by schema validators.
